movie.title: Dear Zachary: A Letter to a Son About His Father
movie.overview: In 2001, Andrew Bagby, a medical resident, is murdered not long after breaking up with his girlfriend. Soon after, when she announces she's pregnant, one of Andrew's many close friends, Kurt Kuenne, begins this film, a gift to the child.

facts: Did you know the filmmaker, Kurt Kuenne, wore an incredible number of hats for 'Dear Zachary'? He personally wrote, produced, directed, edited, shot, and even scored the entire documentary!
The film's subject, Andrew Bagby, wasn't just a close friend; he was a medical resident when he was tragically murdered in 2001. This detail paints a clearer picture of his life.
The entire documentary started as a deeply personal project: Kurt Kuenne originally intended the film as a heartfelt gift specifically for Andrew's unborn child, Zachary.
